message: As we navigate the busyness of life, I’ve been rediscovering the charm of low-tech fun—like gathering around the fireplace with family or sharing stories about our favorite campfire memories. 🔥 It’s also a great reminder to brush up on fire safety and preparedness. Knowing what to do in case of a fire helps me enjoy those moments even more, without a worry. What’s your favorite low-tech family activity?
